ITEM 1 | Small whole green cabbage-like buds (about 2.5-3.5 cm diameter), dark green with some browned and blackened outer leaf edges, tightly layered compact heads, dry matte surface, roasted appearance, clustered on the left side of the plate | 95
ITEM 2 | Single whole red-and-yellow apple (about 7-8 cm diameter), glossy waxy skin with red blush over yellow-green, small stem cavity on top, smooth firm surface, sits at top center of the plate | 180
ITEM 3 | Two halved yellow-orange fruit pieces (each about 5-6 cm across), cut face showing pale cream flesh with a central fibrous core and seed cavity, rim is bright yellow-orange, matte skin, positioned top right of plate | 130
ITEM 4 | Sliced cooked carrot rounds and half-moon pieces (about 4-5 cm long, 1-1.5 cm thick), bright orange with slightly glossy, softened surfaces and some caramelized edges, lying in a loose pile lower right of plate | 110
